_readme: Clean sweeps that predate the mod logs (COTD 1-135), which only a human watching
the cup back can find. A clean sweep = the cup winner was FIRST in every
elimination round. The warmup / discovery round does not count.
TOTALS is the all-time count per player, including the cups that do have a log.
It drives the headline board. Keep 'counts' in sync with Lexer's sheet.
SWEEPS is the cup-by-cup detail, for the sweeps somebody has actually pinned to a
cup number. Anything listed here gets a card on the page with its map and date.
Fields: cup (a plain integer), winner, rounds (or null), source, note.
build_rounds.py checks everything here against cups.json and drops an entry with a
loud warning if the cup does not exist, if that player did not actually win it, or
if the cup has a mod log (COTD 136 onward), where the log is the authority. A total
lower than the number of sweeps we can already name is reported the same way.

totals.note: The cups that have a mod log are counted here too.
